decisions.reason: Identifies the disabled expression in AttachmentChips, explains busy is AttachButton's useState local and unbound here, the empty-occurrence early return, and that plain phase makes the left operand false so busy is evaluated and throws ReferenceError.

Explains the render throw is caught by the slot error boundary which unmounts the whole dock entry, the attach button's separate entry survives, and the error is only in the browser console with no banner.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 line as baseline, proposes hunk-level rollback/re-add and a data-present plain-phase minimal mount, explicitly flags the diff's old-side inconsistency, and identifies imageItem placed before callback-scoped record/status as an additional defect; acknowledges historical timing is unresolved.

Removes the busy reference preserving the phase guard (or lifts state to props), moves imageItem into the map callback, uses (record?.items ?? []) and an instanceof Element check before closest. The alternative one-liner with ?? true is logically flawed (would always skip the viewer), but the primary recommended handler is correct.

Provides a render smoke with a matching occurrence in plain phase asserting chip/remove render and no boundary capture, explains why the empty state misses the line and why node --check only parses, and makes the data-present smoke the minimum pre-ship gate.
